mapper.select: SELECT d.* FROM dispute_ticket d JOIN shopping_session s ON d.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispute_ticket d WHERE d.status = 'OPEN' AND d.sla_due_at IS NOT NULL AND d.sla_due_at < #{now}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispute_ticket d WHERE d.status = 'RESOLVED' AND d.resolved_at >= #{since}
